items.title: Introducing the new AWS WAF security analytics dashboard
items.summary: When blocked requests spike or a customer reports being locked out, a security team has to work out what is happening, where it is happening, and if AWS WAF is making the right call. Currently, that usually means opening each protection pack (web ACL) in turn, across domains, AWS Regions, and Amazon CloudFront distributions, or […]
